WOODWORK — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Growth of timber trees, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Growth of timber trees.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of timber trees.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of timber trees.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket

   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables
